query: Who is eligible to open a Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA)?
expected_answer: Any resident Indian aged 18 years and above can open a BSBDA. Minors can apply jointly or through a guardian, provided the applicant does not hold another regular Savings Account in the same bank.

expected_claims.claim: Resident Indian aged 18 years and above
Applicant cannot hold any other regular savings account in the same bank

forbidden_claims: Only individuals earning over ₹50,000 per month are eligible

query: Is there a minimum balance requirement or maintenance charge for a BSBDA account?
expected_answer: No, BSBDA has zero minimum average balance requirement and no maintenance fees or charges for non-maintenance.

expected_claims.claim: No charges for non-maintenance of minimum balance

forbidden_claims: A penalty of ₹500 is charged if the balance falls below ₹1,000

query: What are the transaction limits for a BSBDA Small Account without complete KYC?
expected_answer: For a BSBDA Small Account, maximum balance at any time is ₹50,000, total credits in a financial year cannot exceed ₹1,00,000, and total withdrawals or transfers in a month cannot exceed ₹10,000.

expected_claims.claim: Maximum balance at any time is ₹50,000

forbidden_claims: Unlimited balance is allowed without KYC

query: Can a customer have multiple BSBDA accounts in the bank?
expected_answer: No, as per RBI guidelines a customer can have only one BSBDA in a bank. Existing regular savings accounts must be closed within 30 days of opening a BSBDA.

expected_claims.claim: Only one BSBDA is permitted per customer in a bank
Existing savings accounts must be closed within 30 days

forbidden_claims: A customer can open up to 5 BSBDA accounts
